title: Annals templates (in-game prose for chronicle entries)
description: Prose templates per chronicle kind. Placeholders in {braces} substitute resolved subject names ({faction}, {other_faction}, {character}, {region}, {technique}, {edict}, {epithet}), the date ({year} as '270 BC' prose, {season}), and any scalar detail key. The variant is chosen by entry id modulo the variant count - stable, no rng. The optional online narrator can replace this prose wholesale; it can never replace the entries.
